FOM121A.how:
How to download FOM121A
  Numarul salariatilor cu program complet de lucru care au fost platiti
  intreaga luna, salariul brut de baza si venitul brut realizat in luna
  octombrie, pe forme de proprietate, pe activitati (sectiuni si
  diviziuni) ale economiei nationale CAEN Rev.2, pe grupe majore de
  ocupatii (ISCO-08) si pe sexe

  THE CALL, ready to copy:
    m.get(select={'forme': 'total', 'caen': 'total', 'grupe': 'total', 'sexe': 'total'})
    1 request

    Why this shape: 'total' on forme and caen and grupe and sexe, since a
    breakdown you did not ask for multiplies the rows without adding an
    answer. Change any of it below.

  NO TERRITORIAL LEVEL: this indicator is not territorial,
  so level= does not apply and get() takes every option.

  FILTERS, all optional. The short name on the left is what you write:

    salariati  Salariati, salariul brut de baza si venitul brut realizat
               3 options, one level
               values: Numarul salariatilor cu..., Salariul  brut de baza, Venitul brut realizat
               a few:  select={'salariati': ['Numarul salariatilor cu program complet de lucru, care au fost platiti intreaga luna octombrie']}

    forme      Forme de proprietate
               3 options, one level
               values: Total, Proprietate publica, Proprietate privata
               a few:  select={'forme': ['Proprietate publica']}
               or one: select={'forme': 'total'}

    caen       CAEN Rev.2  (activitati ale economiei nationale)
               67 options, one level
               too many to list here, see m.options('caen')
               a few:  select={'caen': ['A  AGRICULTURA, SILVICULTURA SI PESCUIT']}
               or one: select={'caen': 'total'}

    grupe      Grupe majore de ocupatii (ISCO-08)
               10 options, one level
               values: Total, Membri ai corpului..., Specialisti in diverse..., ...
               a few:  select={'grupe': ['Membri ai corpului legislativ, ai executivului, inalti conducatori ai administratiei publice, conducatori si functionari superiori']}
               or one: select={'grupe': 'total'}

    sexe       Sexe
               3 options, one level
               values: Total, Masculin, Feminin
               a few:  select={'sexe': ['Masculin']}
               or one: select={'sexe': 'total'}

    unitati    Unitati de masura
               a selector of measures, not a fixed unit: values under different
               options are not comparable, so do not add them
               2 options, one level
               values: Numar persoane, Lei
               a few:  select={'unitati': ['Numar persoane']}

  m.options('salariati')   every option of one of them, in full
  m.get(raw=True)          no derived columns; a 'c' still reads as NaN plus its flag
  m.how(full=True)         the plan, the strategy, the rest

LOC108B.how:
How to download LOC108B
  Autorizatii de construire eliberate pentru cladiri pe tipuri de
  constructii, judete si localitati

  THE CALL, ready to copy:
    m.get(level='localitate')
    42 requests

  TERRITORIAL LEVEL, pick one:
    national          1 unit,     1 request   m.get(level='national')
    judet           42 units,     1 request   m.get(level='judet')
    localitate    3172 units,   42 requests   m.get(level='localitate')   default, the finest
    every level at once                       m.get(level=None)

  FILTERS, all optional. The short name on the left is what you write:

    categorii  Categorii de constructii
               7 options, one level
               values: Cladiri rezidentiale..., Cladiri rezidentiale pentru..., Cladiri administrative, ...
               a few:  select={'categorii': ['Cladiri rezidentiale (exclusiv cele pentru colectivitati)']}

    numar      UM: Numar, mp suprafata utila
               a selector of measures, not a fixed unit: values under different
               options are not comparable, so do not add them
               2 options, one level
               values: Numar, Metri patrati suprafata utila
               a few:  select={'numar': ['Numar']}

  m.options('categorii')   every option of one of them, in full
  m.get(raw=True)          no derived columns; a 'c' still reads as NaN plus its flag
  m.how(full=True)         the plan, the strategy, the rest

    regiune            8 units,     1 request   m.get(level='regiune')
    judet             42 units,     1 request   m.get(level='judet')   default, the finest

  FILTERS, all optional. The short name on the left is what you write:

    niveluri  Niveluri de educatie
              18 options, one level
              values: Total, Invatamant anteprescolar, Alte structuri din..., ...
              a few:  select={'niveluri': ['Invatamant anteprescolar']}
              or one: select={'niveluri': 'total'}

    medii     Medii de rezidenta
              3 options, one level
              values: Total, Urban, Rural
              a few:  select={'medii': ['Urban']}
              or one: select={'medii': 'total'}

TUR101B.how:
How to download TUR101B
  Structuri de primire turistica cu functiuni de cazare turistica pe
  tipuri de structuri, categorii de confort si destinatii turistice

  THE CALL, ready to copy:
    m.get(select={'tipuri': 'groups', 'categorii': 'total', 'destinatii': 'total'})
    1 request

    Why this shape: 'groups' on tipuri keeps the 17 aggregates and leaves
    out the finer breakdown under them, and 'total' on categorii and
    destinatii, since a breakdown you did not ask for multiplies the rows
    without adding an answer. Change any of it below.

  NO TERRITORIAL LEVEL: this indicator is not territorial,
  so level= does not apply and get() takes every option.

  FILTERS, all optional. The short name on the left is what you write:

    tipuri      Tipuri de structuri de primire turistica
                19 options on 2 levels
                'groups'   17: Total, Hoteluri, Hoteluri pentru tineret, ...
                'leaves'    2: Pensiuni turistice, Pensiuni agroturistice
                'total'     1: Total

    categorii   Categorii de confort
                19 options, one level
                values: Total, 5 stele, 4 stele, ...
                a few:  select={'categorii': ['5 stele']}
                or one: select={'categorii': 'total'}

    destinatii  Destinatii turistice
                7 options, one level
                values: Total, Statiuni balneare, Statiuni din zona litorala..., ...
                a few:  select={'destinatii': ['Statiuni balneare']}
                or one: select={'destinatii': 'total'}

  m.options('tipuri')   every option of one of them, in full
  m.get(raw=True)       no derived columns; a 'c' still reads as NaN plus its flag
  m.how(full=True)      the plan, the strategy, the rest
